name: creates files and directories, then lists them in lexical order
test:
fs = InMemoryUnixFileSystem()
fs.mkdir('/projects/api')
fs.touch('/projects/api/main.py')
fs.touch('/projects/NOTES.txt')
assert fs.ls('/') == ['projects']
assert fs.ls('/projects') == ['NOTES.txt', 'api']
assert fs.ls('/projects/api') == ['main.py']
assert fs.ls('/projects/api/main.py') == ['main.py']

name: normalizes slashes and deletes only files or empty directories
input: paths with repeated and trailing slashes
test:
fs = InMemoryUnixFileSystem()
fs.mkdir('/projects///api/')
fs.touch('/projects/api/main.py')
fs.touch('/projects/NOTES.txt')
assert not fs.rm('/projects')
assert not fs.rmdir('/projects')
assert fs.rm('/projects/api/main.py')
assert fs.ls('/projects/api') == []
assert fs.rmdir('/projects/api')
assert fs.ls('/projects') == ['NOTES.txt']
assert not fs.rmdir('/projects')
assert fs.rm('/projects/NOTES.txt')
assert fs.rmdir('/projects')
assert not fs.rmdir('/')
assert not fs.rm('/missing')
